subject: a geometric dahlia bloom
pose: flower low and offset, leaves opening sideways
art_direction: 酒红大丽花的花瓣被简化为几层扇形，奶金和蓝灰让深色不沉闷。
visible_description: 酒红大丽花的花瓣被简化为几层扇形，奶金和蓝灰让深色不沉闷。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Interpret one burgundy dahlia as several broad fan-shaped petal layers, positioned low and slightly left. Add two blue-gray leaves opening sideways and a few pale-gold inner accents. Keep the construction flat and precise, with subtle printed grain inside large shapes. A warm cream field supplies generous contrast, allowing the rich flower to feel poised rather than heavy. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
